loopkeeper.welcome.intro.copy: Start with one person you keep meaning to contact. Set the rhythm. Close the loop.

loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.title: No more “I keep meaning to”
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.copy: Every missed reply starts the same way: “I keep meaning to.” LoopKeeper catches that thought before it cools — it reads the deep context, surfaces the person you owe, and hands you the words while the moment is still warm. The loop closes before the fire goes cold.

loopkeeper.welcome.followup.title: The follow-up engine
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.copy: It reads the deep context and schedules the check-ins you keep meaning to make, surfacing who you owe a reply — the small loops caught before they go cold.

loopkeeper.aboutTxt.what: LoopKeeper is a relationship follow-through assistant — the antidote to 'I keep meaning to.' Choose one person who matters and set a rhythm — lunch every month, a call now and then — and when the moment comes, LoopKeeper nudges you, helps you close the loop, and lights the streak so the care becomes something you can see. One person at a time, never the whole address book: one small, finished win, then the next. The idea at its heart is older than any app — wind the wheel back to 1958.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist1: Young'uns today may not know how crucial it was that a treasured secretary kept the records — connections, relationships, dates, appointments — for the best executives. Nothing forgotten, everything moving smoothly, always.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist2: Before software, the remembering lived on a desk. The Rolodex — Arnold Neustadter's rolling index, patented 1956 and on desks everywhere by 1958 — sat beside the telephone of every capable secretary. One card per person: a name, a number, a penciled note — prefers mornings, ask about the daughter. Flip the wheel, find the face, make the call. The card carried the details so the person at the desk could carry the relationship.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist3: What came next were plastic pocket folders with card slots — the Rolodex name survived across countless iterations. At first they lived on the secretary's desk, the quiet center of the executive suite. Then they became smaller and handier, and every businessperson kept one or several of their own — or synced theirs with an assistant's.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist4: LoopKeeper is that idea, still working: one card per person, holding their story. What's new is that the card answers back — after every send, the Assistant writes what happened onto it, so the next nudge arrives already knowing. A Rolodex that writes back. You supply the caring; the card does the remembering.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.timelineTitle: From the desk to the loop — five eras of keeping track
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era1: Every desk kept its own little archive.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era2: Flip, find, call — one card per person.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era3: The name survived; the wheel left her desk.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era4: The Rolodex shrinks into a pocket organizer.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era5: The card writes back — the AI is the new secretary.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.eraClose: The wheel became the loop. The card writes back. LoopKeeper is that secretary, digitized.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.why: Nearly everyone carries the same quiet debt: the friend you keep meaning to call back, the thank-you that died in drafts, the birthday that slipped while you meant to notice. Nobody stopped caring — life got loud, and somewhere between intending and doing, the fire went cold. An unfinished thing nags at the mind until it's done; psychology has known that since Zeigarnik, 1927. LoopKeeper exists to finish the small ones before they cost anything: a rhythm set once, a nudge when it's due, a message ready the minute you finally have two free minutes. The resolve it offers is simple — the people you mean to keep will hear from you while it still counts.

loopkeeper.welcome.privacySlideCopy: 不要邮箱，不要号码。你加入的人住在这台手机上。发送走 WhatsApp 或电话应用——不经过我们。
loopkeeper.welcome.privacySlideEmphasis: 没有邮箱。没有号码。我们不能给你的人发消息。
loopkeeper.add.prefaceBody: 一个人或几个人。留在这台手机上。我们不留副本，也不发消息。
loopkeeper.add.stayToast: 这台手机上 {{n}} 人。没有发到任何地方。
loopkeeper.walk.weDontSend: 这会打开 WhatsApp 或电话。我们不发。
loopkeeper.walk.polishStay: 正在重写——卡片留在这里
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.surprise: 真正发一条。他们留在这台手机上。
loopkeeper.welcome.card.emphasis: 一个人。一张卡片。关于他们的一切都在那里。
loopkeeper.add.iosBody: Apple 不允许任何网页应用读取手机通讯录 —— LoopKeeper 也不例外，我们很抱歉。你的手机没有问题。两条坦诚的路：在这里逐个输入（每人几秒钟），或等 App Store 上的 LoopKeeper 应用，它会正当地读取。
